findings.title: F expansion production
findings.detail: Start with two F when nf<2, otherwise replenish one F per turn up to min(6,max(2,number_of_unowned_buildings)); spend remaining budget on W. Spawn site greedily minimizes nearest target distance-value; newly produced units are included in same-turn movement.

findings.title: Global diminishing target assignment
findings.detail: Repeatedly take lowest (distance - value + 18*already_assigned + 0.7*min(10,target_enemy_W), flag_index, target_coordinate). Individual F in the same cell can take different targets.

findings.title: Economic value and hidden scores
findings.detail: Value=1.4*score + bonus*min(1,remaining/60). HALL5, ENG5 only while owning none, HOSPITAL4, DEPOT2, LIBRARY1, STATION0.5, WATCH0. Unknown score uses rotation pair, else x-region mean3 or1.5.

findings.title: BFS is geometric path search only
findings.detail: Precomputes all-pairs passable-cell distance at first decision. No multistep action search, forward combat simulation, learned evaluation or opponent-policy rollout.

findings.title: No mission memory
findings.detail: Assignments reset every turn. Only terrain/init persist; previously assigned missions, depot reward receipt, opponent-policy adaptation and temporal commitment are not stored.

findings.title: Late-game policy
findings.detail: Only functional bonuses fade during last60 turns and goals past remaining movement/capture horizon are filtered. No lead-dependent defend switch or terminal tactical solver.

findings.title: Demand allocation
findings.detail: Owned buildings threatened by enemy W within BFS3 or enemy F within BFS2 receive demand local_enemy_W+1 and value+7. Nonowned assigned or enemy-F occupied buildings receive local_enemy_W+1/value+2. Surplus W has soft penalty4 per over-demand assignment, not a hard cap.

findings.title: Immediate F risk avoidance
findings.detail: Enemy existing W at destination or adjacent cells plus maximum affordable W production from any enemy base/hospital are compared with our planned W arrivals. If enemy>ours penalty1000, then distance and0.01*enemy threat. Equal W counts are treated safe for F survival, though both F can contest.

findings.title: Owned ENG discount undervaluation
findings.detail: If we own an ENG, its functional bonus is zero even when valuing defense of our only ENG. Preserving the W discount is not explicitly rewarded.

findings.title: Intermediate W attrition unmodeled
findings.detail: W chooses stay/one-hop solely by BFS distance to its assigned target. No intermediate enemy concentration, preservation or combat outcome term. Predicted vulnerability in narrow defended routes, requires replay evidence.

findings.title: Double-counted demands
findings.detail: The same enemy W within3 of multiple buildings is independently counted in each task. Threat sets also assume all neighboring enemy W can converge on each considered F destination independently. This is a safety upper bound per cell, not a globally feasible joint enemy plan.

findings.title: TELE arrival missing
findings.detail: threat only includes ordinary one-step moves and fresh production. Enemy W could TELE to owned station with no arrival contribution in threat. Own strategy never emits TELE either.

findings.title: Absolute-coordinate tie behavior
findings.detail: Direction priority rotates between Y UDLR and K DURL, but F tuple minimum finally compares absolute target coordinates; W target ties preserve building iteration order and equal-value capture priority also preserves input order. Therefore complete180-degree equivariance is not guaranteed. This does not establish net Y/K strength advantage.

findings.title: Capture budget is approximation
findings.detail: Reserves sum of capture costs for every target within1 of any current F, minus base income10. This may count several alternatives for one F and excludes new F. Actual missions, safety, neutralization or HALL extra income are not jointly simulated.

findings.title: Single greedy spawn site
findings.detail: Same best site is chosen from target distance/value for both F and W and each produced unit. Enemy spawn danger or specific defense demand does not enter site choice.

findings.title: Original 8/8 result scope
findings.detail: Two map seeds0/1, two sidesY/K, examplesLv1/Lv2. 8 wins in29–43 turns. InProcess judgment timing excludes turn IPC/startup; independent stdin/stdout transcript equality is not a enforced300ms match. No strong-opponent or element ablation evidence in this branch.
